functions.name: join_swedish_words
functions.title: Swedish list join
functions.description: Joins a list of words to a comma separated text string in the way words are enumerated in Swedish with "och" (and) before last word. A decision table is used to select output pattern first → `{{word}}`, middle → `, {{word}}`, last → ` och {{word}}`. Parameter `list_of_words`. Returns `joined_words`.

functions.name: join_oxford
functions.title: Oxford serial-comma join
functions.description: Joins a list of strings with an English Oxford / serial comma: A, B, and C. Parameter `names` (list). Returns a string. Decision table JoinOxford (FIRST): first → {{name}}, middle → `, {{name}}`, last → `, and {{name}}`. Not a join_list builtin.

functions.name: coded_text_from_sheet
functions.title: Sheet coded text with equivalent term mappings
functions.description: Looks up the first exact key match in a project Sheet. Parameters: sheet_name, key_column, key, value_column, code_column, primary_terminology, mapping_columns. Column references are header names; mapping_columns is a map of terminology ID to code-column header (e.g. SNOMED-CT → snomed). Returns a complete DV_CODED_TEXT with the primary value/code/terminology and one equivalent TERM_MAPPING (match =) for each nonblank mapping cell. Missing key, text, code or primary terminology returns null; no codes are guessed. Keep codes as text to preserve leading zeroes/decimals. Sheets stay project data and are not bundled.
